fix_code:
N, K = map(int, input().split())
P = list(map(int, input().split()))

C = [-1 for _ in range(N)]

for i, p in enumerate(P):
    C[p-1] = i

ans = 100000000000

from sortedcontainers import SortedList

s = SortedList(C[:K])

for i in range(N-K+1):
    ans = min(ans, s[-1] - s[0])
    if i + K < N:
        s.remove(C[i])
        s.add(C[i+K])

print(ans)
